title: mazus rotundifolius
intro: Mazus rotundifolius, commonly known as round-leaved mazus, is a plant species in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and rheumatism, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Mazus rotundifolius include its ability to reduce fever, relieve cough and respiratory issues, and alleviate joint pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Mazus rotundifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
